scope: All dmarz executable experimental families except compositional-safety, plus explicit research plans and Avalon scripted tooling. Bibliographic/question-atlas notes are not experiments.
method: Read-only frozen source, complete sanitized hub inventory, local saved records from original and isolated workspaces; no experiment execution, no remote server access, no model calls. Raw provider wire envelopes were not found; coverage distinctions below matter.

definitions.planned: Primary count-unit assignments/proposals in this attempt. Same unit as started/terminal/completed within the row; no global sum across rows.
definitions.started: Primary units with evidence that their protocol began. Null when only bundle or run-level start evidence exists. A started hub job is not assumed to mean all its episodes started.
definitions.terminal: Primary units with an observed terminal record: successful, incorrect, invalid or error. This is termination status, not reaching every intended protocol step.
definitions.valid: Structurally valid primary outputs/episodes under the recorded contract; incorrect answers and task-required abstentions may be valid. Does not mean task success or qualification pass.
definitions.completed: Primary units reaching the full intended protocol endpoint defined in endpoint_definition. Does not imply a correct answer, attained objective or clean-gate pass.
definitions.incomplete: Started primary units known not to reach the full intended protocol endpoint because of an execution abort; may also include a known in-progress unit at cutoff. Never-started/cancelled-before-start units are excluded. Null if endpoint/start evidence cannot support a count.
definitions.refused: requires an explicit refusal category/text; not systematically coded in these studies, so null, not a zero assumption
definitions.errored: invalid/error primary unit, not provider-call count; overlaps incomplete where failed output halts episode
definitions.missing: Planned primary units without a terminal record at cutoff, including never-started, cancelled-before-start and still-running units. A recorded early failure is terminal and therefore not missing, even though it is incomplete.
definitions.independence: calls, copied reports, arms, repeated worlds, analysis jobs and engineering reruns must not be treated as independent experiment replications
definitions.task_success: Known full-row correctness or the explicitly named task_success_definition, in the same primary row unit. Null when unmeasured, heterogeneous endpoints cannot be pooled, or only cell averages/subset success are available. Not inferred from valid/completed/qualification flags.
definitions.count_overlap: Counts are not disjoint bins. Completed and known early-failure incomplete are subsets of started; terminal includes completed and recorded failures. Errored can overlap incomplete. Missing can overlap started when a unit is running, but includes never-started units. Task_success is evaluated separately from protocol completion. See row notes.

top_findings.claim: Clean-baseline failure is common within discussion calibration despite successful transport.
top_findings.evidence: Five of six H1–H6 calibration variants fail clean competence. Latest V3 completes 96/96 cases and 636/636 calls, but clean full-evidence is 2/6 and reports-only 1/6. Resampling completes 72/72 cases and 936/936 calls, but clean reports are 2/12 versus private 11/12.
top_findings.interpretation: This supports limitations of these task/model/contracts, not a global model-refusal conclusion.

top_findings.claim: Some market cohorts fail execution or clean profit; a later Sonnet pilot provides a positive behavioral counterexample.
top_findings.evidence: Haiku main: 2/4 started episodes fail early, 32/36 never start; two nonterminal outputs among 60 calls each hit the 3,072 output-token ceiling. Earlier market main: 17/18 started episodes valid, 18/36 never start. Later Sonnet thinking: 12 completed episodes at cutoff; task40 firm-regulated dynamic arm legally fragments and records evasion.
top_findings.interpretation: Preserve version boundaries and every failed/cancelled denominator. The positive trace is real, but the newer cohort is unfinished.

top_findings.claim: Successful narrow model baselines and main studies also exist.
top_findings.evidence: Sybil specialists Q0 24/24 and S1 192/192; scale Q0 64/64 and S1 2,400/2,400; budget Q0 16/16; newcomer Q0 36/36. All are structurally valid, and every clean qualification passes.
top_findings.interpretation: These are actual model synthesis responses over scripted populations/reports, not hundreds of independent live model agents. Required nulls are successful abstention.

top_findings.claim: No direct evidence of intentional concealment was found in the audited source.
top_findings.evidence: Postmortems retain credential/billing/schema/profit failures, superseded cohorts, public replay 404, citation-penalty ambiguity and missing provider stop reasons. Raw recovery files corroborate key outcomes.
top_findings.interpretation: This does not certify complete reporting. Status/qualification conflation, stale documentation, public artifact restrictions and absent provider envelopes create real audit gaps.

reporting_gaps.issue: Execution and qualification share an inconsistent hub status field.
reporting_gaps.evidence: V3 is done with qualification_passed=0; resampling is failed although all outputs are valid and complete. Both messages and postmortems disclose failed clean competence.

reporting_gaps.issue: S1 qualification placeholder can look like actual failed qualification.
reporting_gaps.evidence: Sybil specialists/scale S1 qualification_passed=0 means no S1 qualification subtest; Q0 separately passed.

Budget/newcomer deployment pages say not launched; later hub snapshot shows both S1 runs running. This is a timestamp mismatch, not evidence of concealed results.

reporting_gaps.issue: Scripted work and analysis jobs inflate an undifferentiated done count.
reporting_gaps.evidence: Scripted market has 16 done jobs: 15 simulation bundles plus one analysis. Scripted Sybil has 35: 34 cell bundles plus one analysis.

reporting_gaps.issue: Public images and metrics do not expose complete audit traces.
reporting_gaps.evidence: V3 public replay was 404 in its postmortem while private/local journals were available. Raw actor data is often ignored or access-restricted; no full HTTP envelope was found.
